cognodb.name: CognoDB Cloud
cognodb.resource_source: Observed directly in CognoDB provisioning console on benchmark date
notes: Assignment PDF described the c0 tier as 256 MB RAM, but the live provisioning console exposed 512 MB RAM.
Live console configuration was recorded and used as the actual benchmark environment.

neo4j.name: Neo4j AuraDB
notes: Free tier exposes graph-capacity limits but does not expose a fixed RAM/vCPU allocation in the benchmark console.
Hardware parity with CognoDB cannot therefore be independently verified.

falkordb.name: FalkorDB Cloud
falkordb.storage: In-memory free tier; persistence not included
falkordb.resource_source: FalkorDB Free tier documentation and deployment console
notes: 100 MB RAM is below CognoDB c0's observed 512 MB allocation.
Free tier does not provide TLS, persistence, or backups.

memgraph.name: Memgraph Cloud
memgraph.resource_source: Observed directly in Memgraph project creation console
notes: This trial allocation is materially larger than CognoDB c0.
Results therefore include a resource-tier advantage and should not be interpreted as hardware-normalized engine performance.

arangodb.name: ArangoDB Managed Platform
arangodb.resource_source: Observed directly in Arango Managed Platform deployment console
notes: Exact compute allocation was not exposed in the deployment overview used during benchmarking.
AQL was used instead of Cypher while preserving equivalent logical workloads.
